Set starting volumes before aspirating, e.g. compounds.set_well_volumes(...), nadph.set_well_volumes(...), reaction.set_well_volumes(...) with enough HLM for 5 x 50 uL aliquots. Otherwise the first tracked aspirate from an empty well raises TooLittleLiquidError, and the reaction wells (tracked at 100 uL) run dry after two timepoints. Or leave tracking off.
